_comment: OPTIONAL, hand-maintained (same pattern as the MLB model's public.json). No official CFB injury report exists, so this is the only injury signal CFB spread/ML/totals grading ever sees -- see fetch_cfb.public_cfb_injuries() and RULES_FOOTBALL.md Section 2A/7.
_where: Only a CONFIRMED absence counts -- announced by the team, or actually missing from the two-deep. Never guess at an unconfirmed one; beat-reporter rumor is note-only and shouldn't go in this file.
_how: Copy this file to public_cfb_injuries.json (gitignored is fine, or commit it -- either works) and key it by CFBD school name exactly as fetch_cfb.season_games() reports it (e.g. 'Georgia', not 'Georgia Bulldogs'). Delete a player's entry once they're confirmed back.
_shape: {team: {player_name: {status, position}}} -- status is one of Out/Doubtful/Questionable (anything else scores 0 burden, see model_football.STATUS_WEIGHT); position is the two-to-four letter code from model_football.POSITION_WEIGHT (QB/OL/T/G/C/WR/RB/TE/DE/DT/EDGE/LB/CB/S) -- unlisted positions still count at a flat fallback weight.
